title: Drop the Gloves
cues: Seven minutes left, it's tied at two, and the barn is shakin'
Dark, splintered barn timbers shudder violently, red light flares from the ceiling
intro_or_break
Their number nine's been dancin' through us like the ice is his for takin'
A blurred, silver figure streaks across a frozen expanse, ice shards glint
intro_or_break
I ain't got the hands to score, I got the hands to make a point
Massive, clenched fists rise from a haze of sweat and grit, illuminated by harsh spotlights
intro_or_break
Twelve years in this league, I got a knuckle for every joint

intro_or_break
Coach looks down the bench at me and doesn't say a word

build

build
Tap his shin pads with my stick and tell him, "Hey, nice hair"

build
He says, "I don't fight," I said, "You fuckin' do tonight, I swear"

build
Drop the gloves, drop the gloves, let the whole barn shake

build
I don't score the goals, I make the room they take
